N. Ram on his interview with Sonia Gandhi
results.content: In an interview with The Hindu by N. Ram, former Congress president Sonia Gandhi reflects on her upcoming memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love. She discusses the impact of twelve years of BJP-RSS rule on Indian democracy, defends the Congress party’s fight for a level playing field, and shares how her love story with Rajiv Gandhi evolved into a lifelong commitment to India.
